separation.separate: Separate datasets: financial distress and delivery risk come from different business sources and cannot simply be merged row by row.
separation.imbalance: Class imbalance: only about 3% of the Taiwan companies are bankrupt.
separation.gscpi: GSCPI is merged only with the DataCo operations layer because the Taiwanese Bankruptcy data has no compatible date field.

playbook.label: High Dual Risk
playbook.action: Immediate executive intervention and credit suspension required.

playbook.label: Financial Only
playbook.action: Credit limit reduction and financial health monitoring.

playbook.label: Operational Only
playbook.action: Logistics restructuring and supply chain diversification.

protocol.detail: Maintains class ratios in training and validation sets.
Hyperparameter optimization across thousands of configurations.
Focused on F1-Score, PR-AUC, and ROC-AUC for imbalanced data.
Optimization of decision boundaries on validation data only.
